programs.description: Anu leads an unhappy life as her parents are on the verge of divorce. However, Anu's life takes a turn for the better when James enters her life and they become friends.
Circus performer Sankunni's heart is captured by village belle, Savithrikutty. However, this romantic pursuit is complicated by a rival's sinister intentions, testing Sankunni's resolve and talents.
After his thesis gets rejected and he gets expelled from his college, the idealistic Sreekumar is left with no choice but to take up menial jobs in a pigsty.
Odayil Ninnu
Raghavan hates singers as he had witnessed a terrible life being a son of a classical singer. Sivan, Raghavan's son, faces many challenges when he shows his interest towards music.
Devaraj takes a job at the same factory where his father, retired Captain Ramakrishnan, is killed mysteriously while he is on duty. After he starts working, he must face many challenges.
When Jagadeesh welcomes his old friend, Sethumadhavan, into his home because he does not have a place to stay, he invites his stepmother Bhanu's wrath.
Apputtan, a rich man, gives Ambili, a young woman, the financial help she needs to become a doctor. However, he soon finds himself falling in love with her.
Appukuttan falls in love with Sarojini, who does not reciprocate his feelings. Things take a dramatic turn when Sarojini is found murdered and Appukuttan is implicated in the crime.
